bio.text: Ken Paxton is the Attorney General of Texas and won the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate in the May 26, 2026 primary runoff, defeating incumbent Sen. John Cornyn.
According to his campaign website, he is Texas' 51st Attorney General.
The campaign website says he served in the Texas House and Senate before becoming Attorney General, and ran a law firm in McKinney for 14 years.
It says he earned a B.A. and M.B.A. from Baylor University and a law degree from the University of Virginia School of Law.
